prompt: There is a bug report in ISSUE.md. Fix the code in this folder so the issue is resolved. Do not ask questions; make the fix.
final_response:
Fixed `slugify()` in `textutil.py`.

The changes:
1. **Accent handling** — `unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", text)` decomposes accented characters, then ASCII encoding with `"ignore"` strips the combining marks, so `"Crème Brûlée"` → `"creme-brulee"` instead of dropping the letters.
2. **Edge trimming** — `.strip("-")` removes the leading/trailing hyphens the old regex substitution produced, so `"  Hello,   World!  "` → `"hello-world"`.

Also verified edge cases (`""`, `"!!!"`, repeated separators, other accented words) all produce clean slugs.
